root.label: Jamaal Howard scheduled for Texas execution

events.label: Jamaal Howard scheduled for Texas execution

slots.name: execution count
slots.sentence: A Texas man convicted of killing a convenience store clerk during a robbery was executed Wednesday evening after the Supreme Court declined to halt the execution, despite his attorneys raising concerns about the lethal injection drug used in a failed execution attempt in Tennessee last week.

slots.name: time of death
slots.sentence: Jamaal Howard, 46, was pronounced dead at 8:03 p.m.

slots.name: time to cessation of movement
slots.sentence: His movements reportedly stopped entirely after around 30 seconds, and he was pronounced dead 19 minutes later.
